title: TAT-3848 / TAT-3854 — Perps category pills and sort modal follow the design
description: Proves the design as drawn: the Perps tab carries a wrapping Products chip section with leading glyphs (Figma 13192:28387); the market list keeps one filter row with a measured More menu and 8px-radius pills (12602:45702, 12608:46888); a chip opens the market list pre-filtered and the active pill clears it; and the Sort by modal is one list whose selected field carries its direction inline rather than a separate RANK section (12602:46701). Also photographs the measured overflow at both widths: a popup-width window where the leftovers move into More and a selection made there marks the trigger, and a full-width window where every category fits and no trigger renders.
